meaning:
ἡττάω, -ῶ
(ἡσσ-, 2Co.12:13, see: ἥσσων) [in LXX for חָתַת, etc. ;]
pass.,
1. to be inferior: before ὑπέρ, 2Co.12:13.
2. to be overcome: absol., 2Pe.2:20; with dative, 2Pe.2:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.
promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
